verdict.rationale: Aleph's own bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows include push sync (aleph-docs-2, aleph-docs-1), so data can be moved out into common spreadsheet formats. However, nothing documents a complete, bulk export of all account data for leaving the platform. The trial page's 'cancel and remove your data' (aleph-docs-27) covers deletion, not export. Missing for 10: documented full-account or bulk data export, explicit open-format export options (e.g., CSV/JSON/Parquet), a public API or OpenAPI spec for programmatic extraction (probe found none), offboarding/portability docs, independent corroboration.
